frozen_scope.purpose: Correction-versus-harm separability on development data only.
frozen_scope.sequence_position: AX2 after completed AX1 and before AX3

split.pooled_target_source: signed temporal value from the AX1 frozen prediction bundle

feature_ladder.source: AX1 X0-X3 feature blocks; no new features
feature_ladder.primary_selection_basis: X3_logistic was the strongest stable AX1 low-budget signed-value predictor. It is fixed before inspecting any AX2 outcome.

logistic.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on calibration speakers only

mlp_ceiling_probe.input_scaler: StandardScaler fitted on calibration speakers only
mlp_ceiling_probe.loss: binary cross entropy with positive weight n_negative/n_positive
mlp_ceiling_probe.stopping_rule: fixed 30 epochs; no test-based early stopping

metrics.normalized_auprc_lift: (auprc - prevalence) / (1 - prevalence); zero is prevalence-only skill and one is perfect ranking

applies_to: X3_logistic minus X0_logistic within each target
bootstrap.paired_comparison: The same resampled speaker clusters are used for both sides of each paired comparison.

decision_rules.robust_direction: For X3_logistic, the speaker-cluster 95% AUROC CI lower bound is above 0.50 and the normalized AUPRC lift 95% CI lower bound is above zero.
decision_rules.asymmetric_separability: Exactly one target passes robust_direction and the paired correction-minus-harm difference has a 95% CI excluding zero in the same direction for both AUROC and normalized AUPRC lift.
decision_rules.bidirectional_separability: Both correction and harm pass robust_direction. This means both mechanisms contain ranking signal; it does not authorize a router.
decision_rules.uncertain_robust_asymmetry: Exactly one target passes robust_direction but the paired direction-difference CI includes zero.
decision_rules.no_model_selection_after_results: All outcomes remain diagnostic. AX2 cannot select or tune a final router.
